mainEntity.name: Is this book suitable for non-technical readers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is written in plain English, with practical examples rather than technical jargon.

mainEntity.name: What will I learn from this book?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will get a grounded understanding of autonomous systems, predictive intelligence, cybersecurity, oversight, and the ethical issues that come with AI in warfare.
